title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier With Solid Brass Hardware | Carolina Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade bathroom storage with a wall mount glass shelf that uses three tiers to maximize vertical space while keeping essentials within easy reach.

  • Triple-tier organization: three shelves help add storage without taking up floor space
  • Solid brass hardware: crafted from solid brass materials for enduring everyday use
  • Beveled-edge glass: thick glass with a finished, beveled edge
  • Clean install: concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Coordinated look: part of the Carolina Collection for matching accessories

Specs

  • Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
  • Projection: 5.54 Inches
  • Glass thickness: 0.38 Inch
  • Overall dimensions: 16 Inches (L) x 16 Inches (H) x 5.54 Inches (W)
  • Weight capacity: 6 lb
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4")
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
  • Finish options: available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes

_previous.title: Carolina Collection 16 Inch Triple Glass Shelf
_previous.description: Reimagine your bathroom with this finely crafted triple glass shelf. Traditional styling and superior quality resonate from this hand crafted glass shelf. The 3 tiers of this shelf make great use of your wall space while providing plenty of room for storage. Featuring thick, beveled-edge glass and solid brass hardware this shelf is crafted for durability strength and style.
